title: Verb result envelope
description: What every tool except doctor returns in structuredContent: the outcome of one operator-CLI verb. `data` is present only when the verb printed JSON, so a caller reads structured output where there is some and the text stream otherwise.

verb.description: The CLI verb behind the tool.

exit_code.description: The verb's exit code. 124 means it was killed at the timeout; 2 means this layer refused the call before running it.

stdout.description: Everything the verb printed. Never truncated.

stderr.description: The verb's notes and errors. On a failure this carries the actionable line.

data.description: stdout parsed as JSON, when it was JSON. Absent otherwise.
